layout.description: 12-column cinematic grid — wide screen, generous gutters. Vaporwave perspective floor utility creates 3D horizon grid effect.

_twist.description: Cinematic 12-column grid: 1600px max-width, 28px gutters. Perspective grid floor utility (.vaporwave-grid) creates 3D horizon grid effect with rotateX(65deg). Neon dividers via CSS variable references. Layout utilities: .vapor-full, .vapor-centered, .vapor-split (40/60 asymmetric), .vapor-half, .vapor-third.
